title: Human-Annotated NER Dataset for the Kyrgyz Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a Kyrgyz language Named Entity Recognition (NER) dataset and benchmarking various transformer-based models on it. While the classification labels and examples include terms related to religious institutions (e.g., 'Mosque', 'Muftiate') and social groups (e.g., 'Jews'), the work does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics themselves; it treats them as categories for entity identification.
